verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS IT platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out for Rippling IT. The monitoring and device-data claims concern how admins manage their own org, not the vendor's collection of product telemetry.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
